name: Scrap dealer
text: A dealer with a hold full of junk and an eye for yours. He buys parts, no questions asked, and sells rations to anyone with cash.

choices.label: Sell a part
choices.result: He looks it over, sniffs, and pays. Fair enough.

choices.label: Buy 6 supplies
choices.result: Six crates. He counts the change twice.

choices.label: Move on
choices.result: He's already looking at the next ship.
